description: Speech to text for agents: transcribe a voice note, meeting, podcast or call recording into text with timestamps, in about 100 languages with automatic language detection. Runs OpenAI Whisper (small by default, base for speed) on agentsvc.io itself, the audio is deleted after the call. Send audio_url or audio_base64 (mp3, mp4, m4a, wav, ogg, webm, flac), up to 10 minutes and 24 MB per call. Returns text, detected language, duration and segments with start and end seconds. Also available OpenAI-compatible at POST /v1/audio/transcriptions (multipart file, model whisper-1). Price: $0.01 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"audio_url":"https://agentsvc.io/samples/speech-en.mp3"}.

audio_base64.description: Audio file as base64; or use audio_url

audio_url.description: Public URL of the audio file

language.description: ISO 639-1 code like en or de, default auto-detect

model.description: small is more accurate, base about twice as fast

timestamps.description: Include segments with start and end seconds

name: audio_transcribe
title: Speech to Text (Whisper Transcription)
